objective: Design, formalize, implement, and benchmark the Dynamic Contextual Prompt Generator (DCPG) and resolve the Category Generalization & Model-Compatibility anomaly in PACO for in-person shopping
audience: Torob Physical Shopping Assistant Core Engineers, Product Leads, and Tehran Retail Shoppers
questions: Q1: Category Generalization Anomaly - Why did PACO recommend 6,000-toman coin battery holders from Amjad mall for a 20-million Samsung A54 smartphone?

Q2: Dynamic Contextual Prompt Generation (DCPG) Formulation - How to mathematically and semantically derive ready-made chat prompts from product specifications, brand, model tokens, shop location, and active cart context?
Q3: Cross-Category Token Filtering & Model Alignment Metric - How to prevent accessory category pollution (e.g. industrial 9V clips leaking into smartphone chargers)?
Q4: In-Mall Buyer Psychology & Actionable Prompts - What question patterns maximize buyer conversion, discount bargaining leverage, and floor wayfinding?
Q5: End-to-End Real-Time Latency & Browser Verification - How to guarantee <50ms local prompt generation and verify live browser interaction?
scope: Tehran Torob offline dataset (6,476 shops, physical malls, electronics, mobile, tools, lighting) and Kalam conversational assistant
constraints: Zero hallucination: every prompt must correspond to feasible database queries and actual physical mall realities
Sub-50ms local generation time for prompt chips
Strict model-affinity for branded products (e.g. Galaxy A54 must only suggest A54-compatible cases and 25W chargers)
Preserve backward compatibility with all existing 74 unit tests

acceptance.description: Formal mathematical and heuristic formulation of DCPG (Dynamic Contextual Prompt Generator)
Elimination of the coin-battery holder anomaly in PACO complementary recommendations for Samsung A54
Production Python module backend/algorithms/prompt_generator.py with comprehensive test coverage
Dynamic frontend integration in public/app.js updating prompt chips on product navigation and cart changes
Live browser visual validation showing context-aware prompts and genuine A54 accessories
